name: libvirtualdisplay
purpose: Native virtual display provider of the Host: the control SDK (libvirtualdisplay::driver) is compiled from the pinned source and linked statically into MultitapHost.exe and MultitapHostTool.exe (drivers/display_bridge); the upstream signed SunshineVirtualDisplayDriver package is shipped unmodified as bin/native-display-driver/

sourceArchive.name: libvirtualdisplay-b6874684d82925d0d76f487d8e4ba3ec71c9721a.zip
sourceArchive.treeSha256Method: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text made of one line '<lowercase file SHA-256><two spaces><path below root, / separated>' plus LF per file, sorted by path (ordinal). It identifies the extracted tree even if GitHub ever re-creates the archive with different bytes.

releaseArchive.name: libvirtualdisplay-1.6.5-windows-x64.zip
releaseArchive.notExtracted: driver/SunshineVirtualDisplayDriver.pdb, tools/, vulkan-layer/ and README.md: not used by the Host build or package

signing.channel: self-signed upstream release certificate (not Microsoft-signed, not WHQL)
signing.subject: CN=Sunshine Virtual Display Release Signing
signing.signedFile: SunshineVirtualDisplayDriver.cat (the DLL itself carries no signature; the catalog covers it)

crossCheck: Official Nonary/libvirtualdisplay v1.6.5 release metadata and all thirteen package files were independently verified.
fetch: tools/fetch-libvirtualdisplay.ps1 downloads both archives into .tools/libvirtualdisplay (git-ignored), checks every value above, extracts the source tree and the five release files, and prints both folders (tools/host-installer/build-native.ps1 reads the source tree from there).
build: apps/windows_host/CMakeLists.txt (MULTITAP_NATIVE_DISPLAY_SDK) adds the source with BUILD_TESTS, BUILD_SUNSHINE_VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_DRIVER, BUILD_VIRTUALDISPLAY_TOOLS, BUILD_VIRTUALDISPLAY_PROBE and BUILD_VIRTUALDISPLAY_VULKAN_LAYER off: only the control SDK is compiled, unmodified. The driver is not built by Multitap.
notes: Released Host packages are native builds: bin/native-display-driver/ holds the four driver files above, byte for byte (the build leaves out the .pdb). Changing them would break the upstream catalog; Multitap never re-signs them.
Host settings checks the same four hashes and the signer thumbprint before it installs the driver (apps/windows_host/src/host_prerequisites.hpp, setup_pnp.hpp pins).

GPL corresponding source: a Host build links this MIT source together with GPL x264 and libopus; the pinned archive above, fetched by the script, is the libvirtualdisplay part of the Host's corresponding source.
The Linux kernel-derived files in the upstream repository have their own licences; Multitap does not compile or ship them.
checked: 2026-11-04: original 1.6.5 release/archive/source hashes and INF/DLL catalog membership verified under existing machine trust; matching SDK compiled with 375 project bridge fixture checks. Actual owned-device upgrade/runtime qualification is a separate gate.
